## 0. One-page summary

## 2. Theory cards with hypotheses and feasibility

### (a) Entrepreneurship and startups

#### T1 Effectuation under abundant means
- **Mechanism:** Under Knightian uncertainty, founders start from the means they have. GenAI makes a working product
  cheap and generic, so commitment from customers becomes the scarce resource.
- **Refs:**
  - Sarasvathy (2001), AMR 26(2):243–263, 10.5465/amr.2001.4378020.
  - Townsend, Hunt, Rady, Manocha & Jin (2025), "Are the futures computable?", AMR 50(2):415–440, 10.5465/amr.2022.0237.
